name: Two Fires
summary: The main story (docs/main_story.md v5): 1757-1761, one character. Autumn 1757: a nobody clears land past the last farm at German Flatts and loses it in the raid; on the first night of captivity a burning ship falls out of the sky, and from then on they see a ringed world over the pines and ships sailing between worlds. Four acts: Open Land (the valley), The Sighted (the burned valley), The Upper Sea, The Ninepins (the city of Vessary). Written so far: the vertical slice, missions 1-12 and 14 on the valley's two baked squares (fort_woods and open_land).

start._doc: How a new game of this storyline starts: the survival core's start (SurvivalCore.new_game options) and where the player stands (inside the palisade: Open Land walks them over the ford).

places._doc: Named points on the map, [x, z] in metres (docs/maps.md 1). The stockade (the fort's woods square, centred on 0, 0) stands in for Fort Herkimer, the fortified stone house of 1756 (H), on the WEST bank of the river, which is the real south bank; the river runs north-south through the open land square to the east (its centre x0 = 832 + its meanders, about +-95 m: WorldRiver.x_at), so the game's EAST bank is the real north bank, where the farms burned in 1757 (critic B10). The farms, the mill, the homestead, the raiders' camp and the wreck are on the east bank. Each was checked on the ground (FrontierTerrain.height_at, WorldRiver.surface_at; 2026-10-02): in the open_land square (x 416-1248, z -416-416), dry land, and the distance east of the river's centre is given; only the ford and the ice lesson are at the water by design. The buildings at them come with the 1757 layer (see world): until then they are points with a marker.

_where.fort_store: outside the storehouse door (FortHollow storehouse, door at 6.5, 4.0 facing -x): Vane's counter
_where.fort_wall: on the north walkway by the gate (fort_structure.json walkway 3.0, -15.0): First Lesson's night
_where.fort_church: outside the palisade by the gate, on the fort's flat ground: the stone church with unfinished walls (H: built 1753-67)
_where.ford: the rapid at z 60 (squares.json rapids [60, 40, 0.7]), the river's centre (x 897): about 0.5 m of water, the crossing between the fort's side and the farms
_where.homestead: the Prologue's ground: 112 m east of the river (h -1.1), past the last farms
_where.cache: under a fallen oak 26 m from the homestead (134 m east of the river)
_where.rauch_farm: the nearest farm to the homestead, on the bank toward the ford (72 m east of the river, h 0.4)
_where.flatts_farms: the middle of the handful of farms the game shows (H: about 60 houses burned), 105 m east of the river
_where.mill: by the river, 37 m east of its centre (dry; the mill's creek is still to be cut into the bake, S)
_where.farm_ott: at the top of the farms' bank, 93 m east of the river (h 0.0)
_where.dead_stock: a farm field 223 m east of the river on the way from the wreck to the ford: the raid's dead cattle, the wolves
_where.raiders_camp: on the east bank just above the upper rapid (z -250), 50 m from the river's centre: the fort's smoke in sight across the river
_where.wreck: at the head of the open land on a rise (h 18.0), 332 m east of the river and 36 m inside the square's north edge, about 290 m from the camp: the pine stand the 1757 layer adds
_where.lesson_ice: the east bank's edge of the river below the homestead (z 150), where the ice bears first (the water's edge is about 9 m from the centre there)

world._doc: The world this storyline's years want (docs/main_story.md 3: a storyline's world state; docs/maps.md 1, the year layers). StorySlice applies `layer` (StoryLayer.apply: data/world/layers/1757.json, its farms, church, mill and pines, and its animals' numbers) as the storyline begins or a save brings it back.

animals._doc: The story's valley layers (1757-61) have no mammoths and no bison (H: no record of bison in the Mohawk Valley in the 1750s; verify). Free play keeps data/world/squares.json's sandbox numbers. Horses stay, as strays and free-ranging farm stock (D).

build.flatts_farms: a handful of farms on the east bank: rauch_farm, farm_brenner, farm_wendel, farm_ott and one or two more round flatts_farms (houses, barns, fences); burnable (FireSpread's group) for raid_staged
build.mill: a water-mill by the river (S: a small creek cut into the bake)
build.wreck: a stand of pines round the wreck site (docs/maps.md 1: if the open land cannot carry a convincing stand, bake the cliffs square and put the wreck under its edge)

after.1757_burned: Act 2's layer, from the raid on (Ash, 13): the east bank's farms as ruins (FireRuin), the homestead a black square with its stone root cellar, the fort and church whole. Until it exists, Ash is told (m.tf.ash_told).

_contacts: People to talk to (StoryContact: a lantern and a name tag; E opens the conversation). The director puts them in the world as the storyline begins or a save loads (StoryContact.spawn_for): {id, speaker (a key of data/story/dialogue/<storyline>.json's speakers: the name shown) | name, convo (a conversation of that file), place + offset [dx, dz] | at [x, z], face? (deg), if? (StoryDialogue.holds: shown while it holds)}. The slice's other people (Anna, Jost, Vane, Leclerc, Ithel, Rook) speak in its missions' talk steps, at places; their bodies come with the missions (the missions file's _slice.people: the people effect, the stages).

contacts.speaker: margaretha
contacts._doc: Margaretha Rauch (docs/main_story.md 9.4), with the first of the three warnings (rumours). Her farm (rauch_farm) is a place now but not yet a building on the map (the 1757 layer), so she stands at the fort's cookfire (FortStructures.FIRE_PIT 3.8, 10.6), but not while she stands at her own farm in a mission (StorySlice's people effect sets tf.here.margaretha meanwhile: one Margaretha at a time), clear of the storehouse chests (z 7.6) and the tanning frames (z 13.4); the lantern hangs toward the fire. Move her to rauch_farm once the farm is built (tests/story/test_dialogue.gd reads her place here: move it with her).
